grounding_note: A law listed for a file says how the file relates to it (governing, checked, inspired_only, not_applicable); it is not evidence that the printed shape satisfies the law. Masses are calculated from mesh volume times a card density and were not weighed. No part has been printed, weighed, glided or thrown; no launch is cleared; the lift, drag, stability, beam and catch numbers are hand models or simulated scenarios with assumed coefficients (C_L in particular depends on geometry and flow and generally comes from experiment). Failed thresholds are reported as failed. Frozen revisions are read, never edited; inconsistencies in their prose are listed under findings, not corrected.

relation.governing: the law computed a number reported for these bytes (the computation is in the evidence)
relation.checked: a stated check against this law or rule was executed on these bytes; its outcome is in checks[]
relation.inspired_only: the law or source shaped the design; nothing here checks these bytes against it
relation.not_applicable: the law does not apply to this file; the detail says why

check_status.pass: executed on these bytes and met its stated threshold
check_status.fail: executed and did not meet its threshold (never relaxed)
check_status.unresolved: executed, with a reading or reviewer finding that the threshold does not settle
check_status.unknown: not determinable from these bytes (for example the resin is not chosen)
check_status.not_applicable: does not apply; the detail says why
check_status.withdrawn: the file is not to be printed; the detail says why

findings.detail: Every _R print STL of r1-r3 holds the left part (det -1 export pose). Kept byte for byte; fixed in r4-daane-printfix. Fish-frame mass properties, GLBs and flight models were not affected.

Reviewer claude-13: readings down to 0.097 mm (0.115 mm twice on r3) at the x 20 slot's lateral openings, judged feather edges rather than a thin wall; they can print rough, chip, or cut the band. The builder's sampler classed its own 0.31 mm reading there as edge-limited and did not gate it. r1's body has a reviewer reading of 0.317 mm aft of its catch slot, also edge-limited.

biological_constraints.kept reads 'v3a outline, ray count, ray roots, angles and lengths, fin positions and dihedral', but source_candidate is fish3d-v3c-daane-length. The outline_check itself compared against the v3c candidate's own rays.json (builder code), so the check result refers to v3c; the prose string is stale. The frozen manifests are not edited; a later revision will derive the string from the candidate.

findings.detail: The frozen ASSEMBLY.md cites a 44-60 mm CG window and lists a 60 mm ballast row. That window came from v3a's planform. For r3/r4 claude-07's constraint is CG x 49.5-55.2 mm, target 52.4, never aft of 54.1 mm before the VLM NP, so the 56 and 60 mm rows are outside it.

The frozen 10.5 g threshold was derived on v3a's 52.9 cm2 paired area. It is retained as a legacy threshold; each assembly also carries its own area-specific cap, recomputed here. Every revision fails both.
